name: @stackline/lockfile
description: Maintained compatibility-first file locking with observable asynchronous unlock failures

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:stress
scripts.verify:docs: npm run test:docs && npm run build:docs
scripts.lint: node --check lockfile.js && node --check test/run.cjs && node --check test/stress.cjs && node --check docs-site/app.js && node --check docs-site/check.mjs && node --check scripts/build-docs.cjs && node --check scripts/check-package.cjs && node --check scripts/check-licenses.cjs && node --check scripts/check-packed.cjs && node --check scripts/alias-registry-smoke.cjs && node --check scripts/ci-packed-consumer.cjs && node --check scripts/install-and-smoke-child.cjs && node --check scripts/create-artifact.cjs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run coverage && npm run test:types && npm run verify:docs && npm run check:package && npm run check:licenses && publint
scripts.prepack: npm run lint && npm run test:core && npm run test:types && npm run check:package && npm run check:licenses

author: Alexandro Oliveira
contributors: Isaac Z. Schlueter and Contributors (original lockfile implementation)
